question: Which player among the following won double gold at the 4th Para Badminton National Championship in December 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nitesh Kumar.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nitesh Kumar:-**

 
 
• He won double gold at the **4th Para Badminton National Championship** in **December 2021.**
 
 
 
• **Para-Badminton:-**
 
 
• It is a sport for athletes with physical impairments.
 
• The 4th Para Badminton National Championship was held in December 2021 in India.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Manoj Sarkar:-

 
 
• He​ is a para-badminton player from India who has won several medals in international tournaments.
 
 
 
• Pramod Bhagat:-
 
 
• He is an Indian para-badminton player who won gold at the Tokyo Paralympics 2020.
 
 
 
• Tarun Dhillon:-
 
 
• He​ is a para-badminton player from India who has won several medals in national and international tournaments.
